name: YS LeadGen — Popup & Form Builder
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
YS LeadGen is a WordPress popup and form builder designed for site owners who want precise control over how onsite messages and lead capture forms are displayed.

Instead of showing the same popup to every visitor, YS LeadGen allows you to display popups and floating bars based on real visitor behavior such as page visits, scroll depth, time on site, exit intent, device type, traffic source, and schedule.

The plugin includes a visual drag-and-drop builder, ready-made templates, flexible triggering rules, detailed targeting options, built-in analytics, and lead management — all running fully inside your WordPress website without requiring external services or mandatory accounts.

YS LeadGen is suitable for blogs, business websites, WooCommerce stores, and content-driven sites that need lightweight popups, reliable targeting, and full ownership of visitor data.

Useful resources:
Live Demo | Documentation | Support | Website

What You Can Do

  • Collect email addresses and form submissions
  • Display announcements and informational messages
  • Highlight promotions or seasonal updates
  • Recommend pages or content
  • Show optional checkout or reminder notices
  • Offer downloadable resources
  • Create basic data collection forms

Popup Types

  • Welcome popups
  • Entry popups
  • Exit intent popups
  • Lead capture popups
  • Coupon and promotion popups
  • Cart-related informational popups
  • Light popups for alerts or notices
  • Floating bar popups

Triggering Rules

Control when popups appear:

  • New visitors
  • Returning visitors
  • Exit intent
  • Time on site
  • Scroll percentage
  • Visitor inactivity
  • Auto close rules

Targeting & Display Rules

Control who sees your popups:

  • Page and URL targeting
  • Device targeting (desktop, mobile, tablet)
  • Frequency controls
  • Date range, days, and time scheduling
  • Traffic source targeting
  • URL parameter targeting
  • Geo targeting (country and city)
  • Link-triggered popups
  • Browser and operating system targeting
  • Spam protection options
  • Popup position and animation settings

Templates & Design

  • Ready-made popup templates
  • Seasonal templates (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Halloween, Christmas)
  • Lead capture and announcement layouts
  • Floating bar templates
  • Responsive designs for all screen sizes
  • Visual drag-and-drop editor
  • No coding required

Integrations

  • Mailchimp
  • Omnisend
  • HubSpot
  • Webhooks

Analytics & Lead Management

  • Popup impression tracking
  • Submission tracking
  • Lead details dashboard
  • CSV export support

Why Use YS LeadGen

  • Works fully inside WordPress
  • No mandatory account creation
  • No external SaaS dependency
  • Data stored in your own database
  • Performance-focused architecture
  • Suitable for content sites, stores, and small teams

Credits

YS LeadGen is developed and maintained by YS Innovations, a team focused on building lightweight, performance-oriented WordPress plugins for popups, forms, and onsite visitor engagement.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “YS LeadGen”
  3. Click Install Now and Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu

Getting Started

  1. Create a new popup or form
  2. Select a template
  3. Customize content and design
  4. Set triggers and targeting rules
  5. Publish and review analytics
sections.faq:
Is YS LeadGen free to use?

Yes. The core plugin is free to use. Optional additional features are available separately.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Everything can be configured using the visual builder.

Are popups mobile responsive?

Yes. All popups adapt automatically to different screen sizes.

Does it support exit intent popups?

Yes. Exit intent is supported.

Can I export lead data?

Yes. Lead data can be exported as CSV.

Can I schedule popups?

Yes. You can define start and end dates.
